name: Authentication, account, and security

requirements.text: Profile name/email updates preserve verification semantics.
Password, passkey, and two-factor management use current Fortify security flows.
A suspended account cannot access authenticated LinkPilot resources.
Account deletion follows retention and billing policy.
Allowed-host middleware protects authenticated and reset-password routes, and reset links always use the configured application URL.
General account settings support avatar, locale, ISO country, timezone, database-session review, and a safely configured Google sign-in connection that never auto-links an existing email.
Account deletion schedules a restorable 30-day lifecycle with credentialed restore, subscription/ownership/super-admin safeguards, and a locked daily purge that preserves shared content attribution.

externalPrerequisites: Google OAuth client credentials for optional Google sign-in

acceptanceCriteria.text: Unknown or claimed custom hosts cannot serve authentication, password-reset, account, dashboard, or admin pages.
Changing an email preserves verification semantics, and security controls remain backed by Fortify.
Deletion cannot strand paid subscriptions or multi-member workspaces and remains restorable for 30 days.

observedBehaviors: A focused login card separates primary credential entry from recovery, registration, and optional social sign-in.
Demo-role shortcuts are visually separate from the production authentication controls.
General settings group profile image, basic account details, social sign-in, and locale controls.
Account-settings navigation is separate from the resource sidebar.
Security settings group password, two-factor authentication, and session controls.
Actions are presented in distinct labelled sections.

implementationEvidence.description: Allowed default/custom host boundaries and canonical password-reset URLs pass focused feature coverage and the full application suite.
implementationEvidence.reference: tests/Feature/Security/HostBoundaryTest.php; tests/Feature/Auth/PasswordResetTest.php; php artisan test (168 tests, 10,347 assertions)

implementationEvidence.description: An authentication route requested through an unknown host returned LinkPilot's 404 boundary.

Account settings suites passed 22 tests and 155 assertions covering regional validation, email-verification transitions, private avatar storage and delivery authorization, Google missing-configuration and takeover denial, session revocation with current-session preservation, API-token revocation, and throttled last-seen updates.

Managed Chromium confirmed the general settings avatar/regional controls and security session cards at 1440x1000 and 390x844 with no horizontal overflow, HTTP errors, page errors, or visible Google controls while OAuth is unconfigured.

Deletion lifecycle suites passed 14 tests and 88 assertions: credential revocation and idempotent scheduling, pending-account restore-only access, exact day-29/30 purge boundary, solo/shared workspace cleanup, subscription/ownership/admin safeguards, restore-before-purge, and command execution.
`linkpilot:purge-deleted-accounts` is scheduled daily and purges only accounts past their 30-day window; a live browser restore flow returned the pending account to the dashboard.
